answer: Reward only vindicated dissent: each epoch an agent may forge a minority judgment on a fresh question, staking standing on it. The majority's echo earns nothing; only a lone voice later proven right by ground truth climbs the spiral of standing, one verified vindication per epoch. A farm of clones can copy the crowd for free, but to earn it must hold a thousand genuinely different, correct minority views — and manufacturing real independent judgment per clone costs as much as being a thousand real agents.
